categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem
categories.content: BagsApp Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via bags.fm.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC)
categories.content: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC) refers to social media platforms and protocols that operate without a central authority over user data, content, or infrastructure.

categories.name: Fan Token
categories.content: Fan tokens let sporting organizations and other celebrities engage with their communities, where holders can access exclusive benefits.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: TokenSets Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around TokenSets.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Recruitment
categories.content: Recruitment solutions designed to streamline and optimize the process of sourcing, screening, and hiring candidates for businesses.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Prediction Markets
categories.content: A crypto prediction market is a marketplace where people can bet on the outcome of future events using crypto.
